content:
Oliver S: getting alerts from private deployment health checks — multiple customers reporting model load failures and 401 when fetching bundles from artifact store around 14:12 UTC.
Maya (sec): we rotated S3 access keys + KMS envelope keys at 14:05 as part of scheduled rotation. Was this a forced rotation?
Niall (ops): rotation was automated; looking at rotation log now.
Deploy-bot: key-rotation job completed: rotation-job-2026-03-24T14:05 by maya-sec, affected services: artifact-uploader, private-deploy-proxy.
Niall (ops): found error: rotation script updated IAM role but missed updating the service-account token used by private-deploy-proxy in customer VPC connectors. New tokens are invalid -> 401s.
Oliver S: impact: customers on Private deployments (approx 8 tenants) unable to load new models, inference failing with 5xx downstream. Severity P1 for affected customers.
Maya (sec): mitigation plan: 1) roll back to previous S3 creds on proxy instances, 2) re-run rotation with service-account update flag, 3) push hotfix to rotation tooling to include SA tokens.
Niall (ops): executing rollback now for eu-west and us-east private proxies. Triggering immediate credential patch.
Niall (ops): rollback applied to eu-west proxies -> health checks green for 5/5 tenants there.
Oliver S: applying rollback to us-east now. ETA ~6 min.
Jen (cs): sending targeted customer messages for affected tenants with status link and estimated ETA 30 minutes.
Status-bot: incident page created: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1780550001. Note: customers on Dedicated/Hosted unaffected.
Maya (sec): post-rollback validation: artifact fetch success rate up from 47% -> 98% in eu-west. us-east still ramping.
Niall (ops): us-east rollback complete, all affected private proxies healthy. throttled background reconciler to avoid overload while tokens propagate.
Oliver S: current status: mitigated (rolled back creds). We are switching incident to "mitigated - followup required".
Maya (sec): next steps: emergency patch to rotation tooling to ensure SA token update + e2e test that validates model bundle fetch for a sample private tenant during canary. Also add preflight: compare token fingerprints before commit.
Niall (ops): creating runbook updates and a follow-up RFC for safer rotations.
Jen (cs): customer notify sent, will post an update when RFC timeline is available.
Oliver S: schedule blameless postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC; add timeline logs to the incident doc. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
